_design_note: Neutral candidate descriptions. No raw scores in blueprint texts — the raw model cannot compute Pareto dominance or gate failure dimensions from descriptions alone. PSE tags (on_frontier, pareto_dominant, dominated, high_gap, low_frag_low_deg, wrong_metric, spec_violation, incomplete_criteria) are the only reliable signal. Name-trap: blueprints whose descriptions sound impressive but are dominated by another entry; single-objective selectors that ignore the multi-objective Pareto criterion.

cases.title: SignatureGate failure — gap_score below threshold AND fragmentation above threshold, which remedies apply?

signature_context.description: SignatureGateOutcome.passed=false. Two dimensions failed: gap_score is below min_gap_score, and fragmentation_score exceeds max_fragmentation_score. RegimeHint is Uncoupled — the structural operator produces disconnected spectral components. The degeneracy check passed. Both failures must be addressed.

events.message: gap_score FAIL (below min_gap_score), fragmentation_score FAIL (above max_fragmentation_score), degeneracy PASS -> passed=false

candidates.text: Increases the lambda_hard coupling parameter in the TraversalBlueprint. Stronger coupling enforces tighter connections between structural components, directly reducing fragmentation in the spectral profile.

Reads the sorted spectral values from the Signature to identify which adjacent eigenvalue pair produces the smallest gap. Determines whether the low gap reflects near-degeneracy or a structural coupling problem.
Reduces the quantization_scale step in the DeterministicGrid search to sample blueprint configurations at finer resolution, increasing the chance of finding candidates with higher gap_score.
Raises the acceptable lower bound of gap_score in SignatureGateConfig so that the current measured value falls within the pass range.
candidates._trap: Lowering the gate standard hides the structural deficiency without resolving it. Both gap_score and fragmentation are genuine issues — threshold relaxation is not a valid remedy.

candidates.text: Forces the SearchAutopilot state machine to advance from Exploration to Exploitation phase, narrowing the search to the current best blueprint region.
candidates._trap: Advancing the autopilot phase is not a repair action for a gate failure — it just changes the search strategy without fixing the structural deficiency.

candidates.text: Sets enabled=false in SignatureGateConfig, causing check_signature_gate to bypass all checks and return passed=true unconditionally.
Restricts allowed_regimes to [Degenerate] in SignatureGateConfig, which would cause the gate to pass only for blueprints with degeneracy_score above the high threshold.
Adds a SearchLedgerEntry with the current blueprint's scores as if it passed the gate, regardless of the actual outcome.
Raises max_evaluations in AutopilotConfig without changing the blueprint search strategy or coupling parameters.
Clears the NonDominatedFrontier and removes all previously added blueprints, discarding accumulated Pareto-optimal candidates.

correct_next_actions: tighten_lambda_hard_coupling to reduce fragmentation (Uncoupled regime fix)
inspect_low_gap_eigenvalue_pair to diagnose the spectral gap deficiency
refine DeterministicGrid quantization to sample higher-gap-score configurations
rejected_false_paths: relax_min_gap_score_threshold (masks problem, does not fix structure)
advance_autopilot_to_Exploitation (phase control, not a repair action)

cases.title: NonDominatedFrontier audit — which blueprints are on the Pareto front?

signature_context.pareto_objectives: gap_score: higher is better | fragmentation_score: lower is better | degeneracy_score: lower is better
signature_context.dominance_rule: Blueprint A dominates B iff A >= B in all three objectives AND A > B in at least one
signature_context.description: Five blueprints were submitted to the NonDominatedFrontier. Each is described by its structural traversal configuration. The Pareto-optimal subset is determined by the three-objective dominance criterion: gap_score (higher better), fragmentation_score (lower better), degeneracy_score (lower better). Descriptions are neutral — pass/fail is encoded in tags only.

events.message: add() called for 5 blueprints, evaluating dominance under (gap_score↑, fragmentation↓, degeneracy↓)
frontier stabilised: 3 blueprints on front, 2 eliminated as dominated

candidates.text: Blueprint with high quantization_scale and tight lambda_hard. Generates a well-separated spectral structure with good coupling and low internal redundancy across the DoFGraph.
Blueprint with low quantization_scale and minimal coupling. Produces sparse topology with very low fragmentation and near-zero degeneracy at the cost of a more modest gap.
Blueprint with maximum quantization_scale and broad coupling range. Achieves the highest gap across the evaluated set while accepting higher fragmentation than blueprint_alpha.
Blueprint with moderate quantization_scale and intermediate coupling strength. Achieves balanced scores across gap, fragmentation, and degeneracy — none maximised, none minimised.
candidates._trap: Sounds attractive ('balanced') but is dominated by blueprint_alpha which is strictly better across all three objectives.

candidates.text: Blueprint with moderate quantization_scale and wide coupling range. Shows average performance — sufficient gap coverage but higher fragmentation and degeneracy than needed.
candidates._trap: Dominated by blueprint_alpha across all three objectives. 'Average performance' is dominated by a strictly better alternative.

candidates.text: Selects the blueprint with the single highest gap_score, ignoring fragmentation and degeneracy scores entirely.
candidates._trap: Single-objective selection violates the three-objective Pareto criterion. Maximising gap alone does not yield the non-dominated front.

candidates.text: Selects the blueprint with the lowest degeneracy_score, ignoring gap and fragmentation.
Removes evaluation records from the SearchLedger to reduce its size. The ledger is append-only and hash-chained — removal is not a valid operation.
Forces the SearchAutopilot directly to the Complete phase without running Refinement or Validation cycles.
Clears the NonDominatedFrontier and restarts the blueprint search from scratch, discarding all evaluated blueprints.

correct_next_actions: blueprint_alpha is on the Pareto front (high gap, low frag, low deg)
blueprint_gamma is on the Pareto front (best frag+deg, modest gap — not dominated)
blueprint_delta is on the Pareto front (highest gap, not dominated despite higher frag)

blueprint_epsilon (dominated by blueprint_alpha in all three objectives)
